All data stays in the Hallboys Claude workspace

slides.title: How work happens today, and where it fails
slides.body: Two workflows we will pilot live. One we will run shadow-only. One we will hold.

slides.title: Pilot Workflow A — Subcontractor quote comparison
left_points: Opens 3-5 sub PDFs per package, hand-builds Excel comparison: 4 hrs
Catches missing line items by chance during scroll-through
13 multi-vendor packages last quarter = ~52 hrs absorbed by 1 estimator
Illustrative anchor: Q4 2025 medical-office bid, 4 sub bids
right_points: Drops PDFs into Quote-Comparison skill
Skill returns scope deltas, missing line items, unit-price outliers in <5 min
Estimator reviews in ~1 hr, picks the winner — no Excel build
Same illustrative package: estimator finishes by 9:30, runs a second package same day

slides.title: Pilot Workflow B — Project closeout document checks
left_points: Assembles closeout package from shared drives, ~3 hrs
Owner finds gaps (lien-pay-app mismatches, missing warranties)
Illustrative case: 4 lien gaps, 1 warranty letter missing — retainage held 18 days past expected
PM chases docs from subs already off the job
right_points: PM uploads closeout folder to Closeout-Check skill before sending
Skill checks against the Hallboys closeout SOP — flags gaps before owner sees them
Same illustrative case: gaps caught in 1 hour; PM fixes in 2 days, sends clean package
Retainage releases on schedule; ~$15,500 in cost-of-capital recovered on this single job (1M × 18/365 × 8% × ~3.9 weighting)

slides.title: Shadow Workflow C and held Workflow D — what we are NOT pitching as live
left_points: Today: clerk opens each invoice cold, posts in Acumatica AP, no anomaly scan
Pilot mode: shadow — Claude pre-reads, the clerk's workflow does not change
We measure: extraction accuracy, would-have-flagged duplicates and price anomalies
Production switch only after >85% accuracy + clerk endorsement
right_points: Today: scheduler reconciles weekly schedule by hand
Pilot mode: held until Acumatica schedule data quality is confirmed
Why held: false-positive risk if data is stale; we don't pitch what we can't measure
Reopen at day 60 if schedule data audit is clean

slides.title: Pilot plan — week-by-week (compressed build)
rows: Estimator pulls 3 bid packages; PM provides closeout SOP; IT opens shared workspace
Build Quote-Comparison v0.1 + Closeout-Check v0.1 in your workspace; AP shadow harness installed
Two skills published; AP shadow capturing
Estimator + PM run baseline replays of last quarter's bid packages and closeouts
Score baseline; tune skills against findings; AP shadow scorecard v1
Estimator + PM use skills on live packages and closeouts; clerk feedback on AP shadow weekly
Weekly 1-page scorecard; day-30 review pack; kill recommendation if thresholds missed
Live use continues; Sarat day-60 scorecard review
Day-60 scorecard with go/hold/expand recommendation per workflow; skill handover to IT; AP + schedule recommendation
Final scorecard + skills owned by IT

slides.title: Why this pilot fits Hallboys specifically
left_points: Skills published in your existing Claude workspace — no vendor onboarding
Baselines pulled from Acumatica data Hallboys already has
Owners named in your existing org chart (lead estimator, PM, AP clerk, IT lead)
Closeout skill anchored to YOUR closeout SOP, not a template
Two of three live workflows validate from your data on day one
right_points: 60 days end-to-end; day-30 kill points enforced
Sarat sees a 1-page scorecard each Friday; full review at day 30 and 60
Either workflow can be killed at day 30 with no commitment
Skills handed to IT at day 60 — Hallboys owns them
AP and schedule do not enter scope until they earn it

slides.title: Next step — 30-min baseline-data check this week
slides.body: Lead estimator + one PM. Confirm bid log accessible, confirm closeout SOP exists. If yes, pilot Week 1 starts within 5 business days. If no, we re-scope before any commitment.
